target.statement: MEAN achieves 84.5% accuracy on the MR dataset (sentence-level binary sentiment classification)

compute.basis: No code released; the model (Char-CNN + 4 GRUs + multi-resource attention) must be reimplemented from the paper, and the MR dataset plus GloVe and sentiment/negation/intensity lexicons must be assembled, then trained on CPU.

blockers: No code or configs released, so the full MEAN architecture (coupled char/word embeddings, three attention paths, diversity penalty) must be reimplemented from scratch
Sentiment lexicon is a combination of Qian et al. 2017 and Hu & Liu 2004; negation and intensity word lists were 'collected manually' and are not released
Exact data split of Qian et al. 2017 must be inferred
Training on CPU is feasible but slow; no GPU available
title: A Multi-sentiment-resource Enhanced Attention Network for Sentiment Classification
